prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1382; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, who had entered the intersection from a cross street. Upon arrival, the responding officer observed the passenger-side and driver-side damage to both vehicles and found it consistent with a broadside collision of this type. Witnesses at the scene stated that the crash occurred as Driver 1 described it, and photographs taken on scene were consistent with those accounts. Driver 2 also gave a statement confirming the sequence of events. Officers verified that Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported neck and back pain and was transported for evaluation. The force of the impact appeared sufficient to produce the type of soft tissue injury described. No prior damage to the vehicle was noted by the responding officer, and records indicate Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy covering the vehicle.
